raster_metadata.metadata_source: known PGDA Site04 product/manifest metadata; the successful Moon read used bounded range requests

notes: Official PGDA Site04 ROI 2 centre; 5 m/pix projected lunar DEM.
The product is ~90% interpolated at 5 m; no 90 m observation is invented.

normal.derived_from: central core of the buffered read

bytes.reason: the normal core reuses the buffered read; a separate subset read would add no information and can introduce source-window rounding noise

bytes.measurement_note: Successful separate run; the buffered data ranges totaled 21,004,288 bytes. Later Moon attempts failed at the provider before any values were produced.

core_agreement.normal_source: central core of the buffered read

geomorphon.blocker: GRASS r.geomorphon is not installed in this environment, so no reference 10-class output was produced. Only support/edge-loss was measured; no class values or class fractions are claimed.

blockers.reason: No pinned GRASS r.geomorphon binary is available in this environment; no 10-class reference output was produced.
Curvature buffers and value stability were measured on real DEMs, but no reference-implementation agreement, calibrated scale, or uncertainty propagation has been established.

limitations: Bounded pilot windows, not a global or exhaustive survey.
The buffer radii are method-specific a-priori proposals, not calibrated universal scales.
Normal and buffered common cells use the same aligned 90 m grid; the measured difference is edge coverage and summary bias, not a new elevation value.
Bilinear resampling from 3 arc-second (Earth), 5 m (Moon) and 20 m (Mars) sources was not separated from source interpolation/uncertainty.
COG/GeoTIFF block layout can make transferred bytes larger than the window footprint.
No curvature or geomorphon value is registered, scored, or compared across bodies.

commands.real: uv run python scripts/validate_terrain_buffers.py --earth-site death-valley --earth-site rio-tinto --moon --mars --out docs/terrain-buffer-validation.json --csv docs/terrain-buffer-measurements.csv

run_notes: The Moon window was measured successfully in a separate bounded run; subsequent retries failed at the provider (RasterioIOError: Read failed). The successful measured record is retained and the later failures are recorded, with no imputed or zero-filled Moon values.

provider_notes.detail: One successful LOLA Site04 ROI 2 buffered read (21,004,288 data bytes); later retries failed at the provider.
